PT-1 Sandbox escape through a wazero defect: Pinned wazero with `govulncheck`; fuzzing; SM-13
PT-2 Tampered artifact or mutated tag: Digest on every fetch; Sigstore `enforce`
PT-3 Capability over-grant: Import-derived Capabilities; shims; runtime checks; audit; flagged diffs
PT-4 Auth bypass by a failing Plugin: Auth and authz closed only; audit of `open` enforcing Plugins; Other `open` classes skip on failure
PT-5 CPU loop in a call or `rz_configure`: Deadlines with interruption; discard
PT-6 Memory exhaustion: Page limits; full reservation; pool share
PT-7 Host work amplification: Call budget; log and metric caps
PT-8 Pool exhaustion: Bounded wait; pool share; parked bound; breaker short-circuit
PT-9 Compile bomb: Structure limits; compile in CI and at ingest; one bounded worker; retries, then quarantine
PT-10 Exfiltration: Credential headers hidden without `credentials.read`; redaction; combined-Capability audit; TB-12
PT-11 Cross-request leakage through instance reuse: PDKs zero host data; conformance; recycling (OQ-wasm-plugin-system-18)
PT-12 Side channels between Plugins: None; Not mitigated
PT-13 Signature checks disabled: `off` is explicit and degraded
PT-14 Tampered compiled-code cache: Compiled code never persisted
PT-15: During a trip, `open` Plugins are bypassed and `closed` Plugins deny for 95% of traffic (target)
PT-16 State key collision, flooding or displaced settlement: Namespaced keys; limits (OQ-wasm-plugin-system-19)
PT-17 Header injection or request smuggling: Write validation; framing recomputed
PT-18 Registry SSRF or credential leak: Host allowlist; address refusal
PT-19 Decisions on spoofable input: Trusted-edge rule; authenticated split attributes
